INTEGRATIONS.ACTIVE_LINE_1: /find <name> — instant search for items with action buttons.
INTEGRATIONS.ACTIVE_LINE_3: /locations — interactive guide to your storage structure.
INTEGRATIONS.ACTIVE_LINE_5: /add <name> — quick creation of new item with «Active» status.
INTEGRATIONS.ACTIVE_LINE_6: 🔔 Automatic push notifications on event date.
INTEGRATIONS.STEP_2: Click on the blue «Go to Telegram bot» button that appears.
INTEGRATIONS.STEP_3: In the opened Telegram chat, click «Start» button at the bottom.

DASHBOARD.WELCOME_DESC: Let's walk through main sections so you can easily navigate the app right away.
DASHBOARD.HEADER_DESC: Switch themes, languages, open profile and settings here.
DASHBOARD.STATS_DESC: Top block shows general summary: how many items you have, what is sold, lent, and where actions are required.
DASHBOARD.STATS_LOCATIONS_DESC: Clicking card will quickly take you to storage places list. We'll discuss them in detail next.
DASHBOARD.STATS_ITEMS_DESC: Main list of all your items. Tables and filters overview will be on your first visit to this section.
DASHBOARD.STATS_SALES_DESC: Tracking sold items and clear totals. Details will be explained inside section itself.
DASHBOARD.STATS_LENT_DESC: List of items you lent to someone or borrowed yourself.
DASHBOARD.STATS_ATTENTION_DESC: Overdue reminders, expiring warranties, and important events end up here.
DASHBOARD.LOCATIONS_DESC: Switch between major storage places for quick scrolling to needed block.
DASHBOARD.BOARD_DESC: Main area. Each card is a separate place (room, closet, garage) where your items reside.
DASHBOARD.CREATE_FIRST_DESC: Click here to add your first place and start organizing.
DASHBOARD.FEEDBACK_BTN_DESC: Found a bug or have an idea? Click here anytime — we read every message.
DASHBOARD.FOOTER_DESC: Support, terms, and developer contact are always at bottom of page.

ITEMS_LIST.WELCOME_DESC: A visual list of all your items in a convenient table.
ITEMS_LIST.FILTERS_DESC: Search items by name, sort by categories, places, statuses, or open archive.
ITEMS_LIST.TABLE_DESC: Check multiple items for bulk deletion or use icons on right for viewing and editing.

SALES_LIST.WELCOME_DESC: Entire history of your successful deals and financial metrics is displayed here.
SALES_LIST.FINANCE_DESC: Summary of your total revenue and net profit considering multi-currency.
SALES_LIST.FILTERS_DESC: Use search by name, category/platform filters, and sorting by date or profit.
SALES_LIST.ACTIONS_DESC: Cards with detailed sales information. From here you can cancel deal or delete record.

LOCATION_FORM.WELCOME_DESC: Physical storage place is created here (e.g., Garage, Shelf, Red box).
LOCATION_FORM.NAME_DESC: Enter clear name. If creating shelf inside closet — it will automatically link to it.
LOCATION_FORM.COLOR_DESC: Select color from palette to quickly find desired card on board.
LOCATION_FORM.CUSTOM_COLOR_DESC: Eyedropper icon allows selecting any exact color.

ITEM_FORM.WELCOME_DESC: Detailed item card is created here: photos, purchase history, warranty, and statuses.
ITEM_FORM.PHOTO_DESC: Upload one or several photos. Main photo can be selected simply by clicking it.
ITEM_FORM.NAME_DESC: Name item simply and clearly (e.g., «Bosch Hammer Drill» or «Winter Jacket»).
ITEM_FORM.DESC_DESC: Serial numbers, package contents, dimensions, or important details can be entered here.
ITEM_FORM.CATEGORY_DESC: Group items by types (Tools, Clothing, Electronics) so they are easy to find.
ITEM_FORM.ADD_CATEGORY_DESC: Click here if needed category is not in list — it can be added right while filling form.
ITEM_FORM.LOCATION_DESC: Specify exactly which place or box item is located in.
ITEM_FORM.STATUS_DESC: Mark state: «In stock», «Lent», or «Borrowed». Date and name fields will appear.
ITEM_FORM.FINANCIALS_DESC: Check box to specify price and purchase date to calculate total cost of all items.
ITEM_FORM.RECEIPT_DESC: Save warranty expiration dates and receipt scans — app will remind you before warranty ends.
ITEM_FORM.REMINDER_DESC: Set up scheduled maintenance, consumable replacement, or subscription renewal with Telegram or Email alerts.

FIRST_LOCATION_CARD.WELCOME_DESC: Great! This is now your workspace. Let's go over the control buttons.
FIRST_LOCATION_CARD.MAIN_ADD_ITEM_DESC: The 'Create Item' button is now available on the stats panel for quick item additions.
FIRST_LOCATION_CARD.HEADER_DESC: Here you can view details, edit, delete, and select a parent location.
FIRST_LOCATION_CARD.ADD_NESTED_DESC: Click 'Create Location' to create a space INSIDE this one (e.g., Closet inside Room).
FIRST_LOCATION_CARD.ADD_ITEM_DESC: Click 'Create Item' to place a new item here right away.

FIRST_ITEM_CARD.WELCOME_DESC: Congratulations! Here is how to manage this card now.
FIRST_ITEM_CARD.DRAG_DESC: Hold card with mouse and drag it to any other place on board.
FIRST_ITEM_CARD.INFO_DESC: Eye icon will open detailed item page with photos, notes, and documents.
FIRST_ITEM_CARD.MENU_DESC: Three dots open menu: edit, lend, sell, or delete item.

SELL_FORM.WELCOME_DESC: Fill in sale amount and platform to record profit and remove item from storage.
SELL_FORM.ADD_PLATFORM_DESC: Click here if needed marketplace (OLX, eBay, Amazon, etc.) is not in list yet.

FIRST_SALE_CARD.WELCOME_DESC: Congratulations! Item moved to deal archive.
FIRST_SALE_CARD.INFO_DESC: Shows date, selling price, and your net profit (revenue minus purchase price).
FIRST_SALE_CARD.UNDO_DESC: If customer returned item or deal fell through — click this button to restore item to any location.

LANDING.HERO_TITLE: Bring order to your things once and for all
LANDING.HERO_SUBTITLE: INest is your digital organizer. Track item locations, warranties, sold, and lent items in a few clicks.
LANDING.FEATURE_1_DESC: Create structures of any complexity: Home -> Closet -> Second shelf. Find anything in seconds.
LANDING.FEATURE_2_DESC: Keep track of who borrowed your tools and how much you sold your old gear for.
LANDING.FEATURE_3_DESC: Search items, check status, and get reminders right inside the messenger.
